bioconda.name: gc-meox-tms
bioconda.summary: In-silico MeOX/TMS derivatization of chemical compounds.
bioconda.description: This package performs in-silico methoximation (MeOX) and trimethylsilylation (TMS) of chemical compounds from SMILES strings or RDKit molecule objects. It also can identify whether a given compound is already derivatized by MeOX or TMS method.
